_doc: Curated technique seeds (knowledge_architecture.md section 5), one file per area. Fields: id, level + scope (a scope node or universal), aliases (v1 / technique-DB / footer names folded in), mechanism, preconditions (predicate DSL), predicts (canonical metric -> up|down|flat|up_or_flat|down_or_flat), risks (pitfalls), states / op_classes / op_kinds gates (empty = any), slot (offered by the multi-slot agent), prior {mean, n}: a seed prior with a low pseudo-count that evidence overrides, realizations by scope (target:<key> | target:<backend>:sm_NN+ | target:<backend> | node:<id> | universal). Loaded by Ontology.seed(); scripts/seed_knowledge.py builds a knowledge.db from these files.

techniques.mechanism: choose tile_I/J/K so A and B tiles fit the scratchpad and the C tile fits the accumulator, maximising reuse per DMA

realizations.how: tiled_matmul_auto / tiled_matmul with explicit tile_I, tile_J, tile_K in multiples of DIM (16) such that (I*K + K*J) * DIM^2 bytes <= 256 KiB scratchpad and I*J*DIM^2*4 bytes <= 64 KiB accumulator.

techniques.mechanism: keep partial sums in the accumulator across the K loop and apply scale / bias / ReLU on mvout

realizations.how: preload with accumulate=1 over k tiles; mvout from the accumulator with the activation and scale fields (no separate elementwise pass).

techniques.mechanism: weight-stationary vs output-stationary: pick the dataflow that keeps the larger reused operand in the array

realizations.how: WS when the weight tile is reused across many input rows (large M), OS when K is long and outputs are few; dataflow argument of tiled_matmul.

techniques.mechanism: let the convolution engine generate im2col rows from the scratchpad instead of materialising them in DRAM

realizations.how: tiled_conv_auto (hardware im2col) with input in NHWC; fall back to tiled_matmul on a host-side im2col only for unsupported strides.
